problem.label: The Real Problem
problem.heading1: The problem usually isn't one broken system.
points: Your ERP handles one part of the business.
Old software becomes harder to change.
And every new tool adds another layer instead of removing one.
problem.closing: Eventually, your team spends more time working around the software than the software spends working for them.

about.p1: You need people who can understand why the system is failing, decide what should change, build it without creating another layer of complexity, and stay responsible after launch.
about.p2: We start with how your business actually operates, not with a preferred framework or a prepackaged product.

projects.name: DACAR by UNDP
projects.problem: Event-based cash fund distribution for organized field operations required strict compliance, rigorous recipient identity validation, and transparent audit trails with zero tolerance for delays or duplicate disbursements.
projects.work: Architected and engineered a comprehensive cross-platform digital ecosystem (field officer mobile app, administrative web portal, resilient backend services, and encrypted database infrastructure) ready for international cloud deployment standards.
projects.result: Successfully deployed an accountable digital disbursement platform featuring real-time recipient verification, complete transaction audit trails, and zero manual paper reconciliation in the field.

projects.name: E-Office
projects.problem: Managing incoming and outgoing official letters, executive dispositions, and physical paper archives caused coordination bottlenecks, risks of misplaced records, and zero tracking over executive directive follow-ups.
projects.work: Built a modular web administration platform featuring automated multi-tier disposition routing, systematic letter numbering, granular role-based access control (RBAC), and full-text indexed digital archive search.
projects.result: Enabled real-time end-to-end tracking of correspondence and document dispositions, accelerating cross-departmental administrative turnaround and significantly cutting paper dependency.

projects.name: Oetomo Hospital Website
projects.problem: Patients and families required a fast, trusted, and mobile-first official hospital portal to verify specialist doctor schedules, outpatient/inpatient facilities, and emergency care guidance.
projects.work: Engineered a high-speed responsive institutional website integrated with an intuitive CMS, dynamic specialist doctor scheduling directories, and patient-first medical information architecture.
projects.result: Established a centralized digital presence that strengthens hospital brand credibility, helps patients find medical schedules within seconds, and empowers internal staff to update content independently.

servicesPage.title: What We Offer
servicesPage.subtitle: Five core services designed to solve real operational problems, not just add new technology.

modernization.problem: Your software can no longer keep up with business needs
modernization.title: Legacy System Modernization
modernization.desc: We fix legacy platforms without endangering ongoing operations: redesigning architecture, replacing weak components, and preparing systems for future growth.
modernization.outcome: Faster changes. Better reliability. Less technical debt.
modernization.details: Legacy system modernization is a careful process. We don't rewrite everything from scratch. Instead, we analyze the existing system, identify components that still work well, and replace only the parts that hinder operations. This approach minimizes risk and ensures business continuity during modernization.

deliverables.title: System Dependency Map
deliverables.desc: Comprehensive architectural visualization mapping module relationships, databases, internal/external APIs, and single points of failure.

deliverables.title: Retention & Refactor Matrix
deliverables.desc: Objective cost-benefit recommendations identifying which legacy components to preserve, which to wrap in APIs, and which require rewriting.

deliverables.title: Phased Migration Plan & Runbook
deliverables.desc: Milestone rollout strategy (Strangler Fig pattern) with zero-downtime cutover procedures and safety-first rollback plans.

caseStudy.name: DACAR by UNDP
caseStudy.problem: Field emergency cash distribution previously relied on paper-based validation susceptible to double-disbursement and slow reconciliation cycles.
caseStudy.role: Sundawa re-architected legacy infrastructure into modular microservices, field mobile applications, tiered verification backoffice, and encrypted databases.

automation.problem: Too many tasks are still done manually
automation.title: Workflow Automation & AI
automation.desc: We transform approvals, reporting, document processing, data entry, and repetitive operational tasks into controlled automated workflows.
automation.outcome: Less repetitive work. Faster operations. Fewer errors.
automation.details: Automation isn't just about eliminating manual work. It's about creating consistent, measurable, and monitorable workflows. We identify repetitive tasks, design automated flows, and integrate them with existing systems. AI is used when it truly adds value, not as a gimmick.

deliverables.title: Workflow & Bottleneck Diagnostic Map
deliverables.desc: Detailed operational audit pinpointing manual cycle times, human-error friction points, and measurable labor-hour savings per department.

deliverables.title: Controlled Automation & AI Engine
deliverables.desc: Production-ready automation pipelines with human-in-the-loop safeguards for document parsing, rule-based approvals, and cross-platform sync.

deliverables.title: Real-time Monitoring & Audit Logging Dashboard
deliverables.desc: Operational monitoring interface tracking execution health, end-to-end audit trails, and automated instant failure alerts.

caseStudy.badge: Reference Case Study · Workflow Automation & Archiving
caseStudy.name: E-Office
caseStudy.problem: Incoming official mail, tiered leadership approval routing, and physical archiving took 3–5 business days per document with high misplacement risks.
caseStudy.role: Sundawa developed an automated web workflow with systematic letter numbering, instant hierarchical routing, and indexed digital archiving.

integration.title: System & Data Integration
integration.desc: We connect ERP, financial systems, databases, APIs, operational systems, and external platforms so information flows to the right place.
integration.outcome: One information flow, not isolated systems.
integration.details: System integration starts with understanding how data flows between existing systems. We map dependencies, identify integration points, and build reliable connectors. The result is information that flows automatically to the right place, without duplication or inconsistency.

caseStudy.subject: Commercial Banks, Regional Banks (BPD) & BPRs: Branchless Banking Ops, Risk & Compliance, and Enterprise Architecture
caseStudy.challenge: Scaling field agent networks across low-signal regions risks double-debits or stuck UNKNOWN transactions, outlet location spoofing, agent float shortages, slow manual reconciliation, and unapproved fee or limit modifications.
caseStudy.solution: A 3-layer Control by Design architecture pairing a Flutter field agent mobile app (hardware-bound device keys & GPS/WiFi BSSID geofencing) with a Maker-Checker bank operations portal, 4-way reconciliation, and real-time operations cockpit.
caseStudy.architecture: On-premise container cluster (RHEL 9 Podman/Docker, Kubernetes/OpenShift) across Primary DC + Hot Standby DRC, ISO 8583/20022/REST/SOAP Core Adapters, OAuth2/SAML IAM, SHA-256 hash-chained ledger, and zero-payload FCM wake signals.
caseStudy.impact: Enforces auditable banking control from day one: four-eyes segregation preventing self-approval on fees/limits, deterministic idempotency in weak connectivity, full data sovereignty in bank DC/DRC, and phased MVM-1 to MVM-2 delivery.
highlights: 3-layer architecture across field, backoffice & DC/DRC
6 built-in controls from Maker-Checker to SHA-256 ledger
ISO 8583, ISO 20022, REST & SOAP Core Banking Adapters

scenarios.title: Transaction Certainty in Low Signal
scenarios.outcome: Idempotency guard with deterministic UNKNOWN resolution eliminates double-debits in field areas.

scenarios.title: Four-Eyes Governance & 4-Way Recon
